caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object depicted is a sculpture or bust resembling a human head, colored in shades of dark green, brown, and hints of black, suggesting a metallic or weathered stone surface. The head shows detailed facial features including eyes, nose, mouth, and ears, and is adorned with what appears to be a cap or head covering. The sculpture sits on a small, round base. There is a hand-written signature in small letters toward the bottom right of the drawing that reads "Paul Poyinbarger." The composition is simple with the main figure occupying the central portion of the otherwise empty background.
title: Iron Negro Bank
